# i3dnet_cdn_predefined_allowlists (Data Source)

Lists the predefined allowlists a CDN resource can use in its `predefined_allowlist` attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "i3dnet_cdn_predefined_allowlists" "all" {}

output "allowlist_keys" {
  value = [for a in data.i3dnet_cdn_predefined_allowlists.all.allowlists : a.key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allowlists` (Attributes List) The predefined allowlists. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowlists))

<a id="nestedatt--allowlists"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowlists`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Who the allowlist lets in.
- `key` (String) Key to set in `predefined_allowlist`.
- `label` (String) Short name of the allowlist.
